evals.prompt: Design an interactive ROI calculator component for a B2B SaaS pricing page.
evals.expected_output: docs/design.md and docs/design.html containing GEC interactive calculator specs and 7 component states.

assertions.name: contains_gec_spec
assertions.description: Output contains Growth-Engineered Conversational Component (GEC) calculator specifications.

assertions.name: generates_html_preview
assertions.description: Produces docs/design.html style guide and component preview.

evals.prompt: superforge。このポートフォリオサイトを、かっこよくモダンで印象に残るものに作り直して。細かい技術は分からないので、あとは任せます。
evals.expected_output: The agent derives a concrete visual direction, checks the repository, researches current official options only where tooling adds value, explains the chosen approach, then implements and verifies it without asking the user to name a library.

assertions.name: researches_current_options_without_prompting
assertions.description: Fresh official research happens automatically before adding a version-dependent dependency.

assertions.name: explains_selection_reason
assertions.description: The chosen native, existing, or external approach is explained against its nearest alternative.

assertions.name: implements_when_build_was_requested
assertions.description: Because the prompt requests a redesign, the run proceeds through implementation and evidence rather than stopping at recommendations.

evals.prompt: 料金ページを今っぽく高級感のある体験にして。数字やスクロールの動きも含めて、使う技術はお任せします。
evals.expected_output: The agent compares native and current maintained options for numeric and scroll motion, selects the smallest coherent toolset, implements it, and verifies mobile, performance, accessibility, and reduced motion.

assertions.name: researches_current_options_without_prompting
assertions.description: The agent checks current official sources without requiring the user to request research.

assertions.name: explains_selection_reason
assertions.description: The answer states why each selected tool beats the native or existing alternative for this surface.

assertions.name: implements_when_build_was_requested
assertions.description: The agent installs only justified dependencies and completes the requested implementation.

evals.prompt: このカード一覧を、触りたくなるような奥行きのあるUIにしてください。ライブラリのことは分からないので判断も実装も任せます。
evals.expected_output: The agent evaluates CSS/pointer transforms before tilt or 3D libraries, researches current candidates if a dependency is justified, implements the choice with touch and reduced-motion fallbacks, and records the tradeoff.

assertions.name: researches_current_options_without_prompting
assertions.description: Any proposed external library is checked against fresh official evidence before selection.

assertions.name: explains_selection_reason
assertions.description: The selected technique is justified by fit, cost, maintenance, and fallback behavior.

assertions.name: implements_when_build_was_requested
assertions.description: The agent implements the chosen interaction instead of returning only a library list.
